name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
archDisplay: Proprietary model; architecture and parameter count undisclosed; adaptive thinking with a runtime effort parameter, 1M-token context
note: Model id claude-sonnet-5-5, released 2026-09-28 as 'the second model in the Claude 5.5 family'. Anthropic says it runs 30%+ faster than Sonnet 5 and costs up to 30% less per task. List price matches Sonnet 5 at $2/$10. Cache reads launched at $0.20 and were halved to $0.10 on 2026-10-07. It is the first Sonnet to ship with cyber safeguards, which fall back to Sonnet 5. Anthropic says Opus 5.5 is 'clearly stronger at complex, open-ended work' despite similar Max-effort benchmark scores. Its Terminal-Bench 4.0 score (70.6) beats Opus 5.5's (66.4).
